items: Volunteer scheduling at Oakfield Food Bank
Shift coverage is slipping as volunteer numbers grow
A three-month pilot will test the app with two shift teams.
We recommend a volunteer booking app
How can coordinators fill shifts with less effort?
Coordinators spend about 4 hours a week chasing replies
Last-minute gaps are filled by the same few people
30% of shifts are unfilled at least once a month
Most volunteers would use an app (9 of 12 surveyed)
Reminders were the most wanted feature
Paper rota on the warehouse wall
Option comparison: WhatsApp, shared spreadsheet, booking app
We recommend adopting a volunteer booking app.
Next steps: explore options with the board
Survey sent to the volunteer WhatsApp group
